name: native collection iterator next validates and uses its receiver
source: function main():void { const m=new Map<string,number>(); m.set("a",1); const a:any=m; const it:any=a.keys(); const next:any=it.next; try { next(); console.log("accepted"); } catch(e:any) { console.log(e instanceof TypeError); } console.log(it.next().value); const other:any=a.keys(); console.log(next.call(other).value); const real:any=new Map([["x",1]]); const ri:any=real.keys(); console.log(next.call(ri).value); }
